question.text: After re-tagging of an IA's benchmark or Strategy, the PM shall NOT use which of the following for performance reporting?

answer.text: Pre-re-tagging performance track record of that IA

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XXI-A workbook (page 131), once the benchmark or Strategy tagging of an Investment Approach is changed, the pre-change performance track record of that IA shall not be used for performance reporting. The Trap: Post-re-tagging returns may continue to be reported; only the pre-change track record is barred. Note: Source: NISM Series XXI-A workbook, page 131.
